environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the Kafka consumer with default seccomp profile (runtime/default). Container runs as non-root (uid 1000) but has NET_RAW capability retained. Backend services on 8081/8082 are plain HTTP servers running gunicorn with default request parsing. No network policies restrict egress from the consumer pod. Kafka topic 'api-gateway-raw-requests' is writable by any authenticated producer in the cluster.
